statement: Storage, as used in the estimate, is the amount of space required to store the data; for the online/offline indicator it is tiny because only two integers per user are stored.
detail: Stated while concluding that storage is not the challenge for this system (8 GB even for a billion users); sets up the later contrast that the challenge is something else (computation, picked up in part 2).
